simple.meaning: חָרַד (chârad) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to shudder with terror; hence, to fear ; also to hasten (with anxiety).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 39 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Judges, and 15 more, beginning at Genesis 27:33. Its contexts include family, family line, land, mountain.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָרַד (H2729).

definitions.short: to shudder with terror; hence, to fear ; also to hasten (with anxiety)
